verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an inference SDK and engine, so multi-GPU distribution is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only documents on-device execution on whatever silicon the device has (e.g., the Hexagon NPU and Metal GPUs) and hosted cloud models. Nothing documents tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism across multiple GPUs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can distribute inference across multiple GPUs using tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism
